## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

When prefill attention TP is smaller than decode attention TP (e.g. TEP4 prefill -> TEP8 decode), each decode rank holds only part of a prefill rank's KV heads, so the prefill rank sends each of those decode ranks a head slice of its full-attention KV and SWA state.

Currently, each NIXL descriptor moves one small per-token head-slice region, per layer and per K/V. At high concurrency, posting that many small transfers becomes the bottleneck.

This PR gathers each decode rank's head slices into a contiguous GPU buffer first, so each descriptor moves a whole destination page. The speedup comes from page-sized transfers replacing per-token head-slice transfers.


## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->
Optional KV packing on prefill (`SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_KV_PACKING=1`, default off):

- `disaggregation/nixl/packed.py`: `PackedKVSender` gathers a decode rank's head slice of each page into a registered GPU buffer (`SGLANG_NIXL_KV_PACK_BUFFER_SIZE_MB`, default 64) with the existing staging Triton gather kernel, then posts one transfer request per batch with one page-sized descriptor per tensor and page.
- `disaggregation/nixl/conn.py`: one packer per transfer worker. When prefill attention TP < decode attention TP, full-attention KV and SWA state go through the packer; equal TP and prefill TP > decode TP keep the existing paths. The transfer worker now honors the early-send `wait_event`, as Mooncake does.
- `disaggregation/utils.py`: `kv_packable` marks SWA hybrids whose full and SWA pools are NHD `MHATokenToKVPool`s with equal K/V head dims and the same head count, without draft KV (each pool is gathered with one page size, and both are sliced with the full-attention head count).
- `environ.py`: the two variables.

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

Muse Spark Open NVFP4, TEP4 prefill / TEP8 decode on 12 GB300 via Dynamo, packing on, 1M context, no speculative decoding. <!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

Same tree and nodes for both columns; only `SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_KV_PACKING` differs (0 = off, 1 = on). [by Claude Code] **Severity: functional | Confidence: High**

**Issue**

When `self.agent.transfer(handle)` returns `"ERR"` (line 150), `send()` raises but leaves `self.inflight` set to that failed handle. The next `send()` on this worker calls `_wait()`, sees `ERR`, and raises `"NIXL packed transfer failed"`. That fails a different room, even when its peer is healthy.

**Example**

Room X posts to a disconnected decode peer and fails. Room Y is next on the same transfer worker and goes to a healthy peer, but it also fails. I reproduced this on CPU with a fake NIXL agent.

**Fix**

Raise on `ERR` only for handles that the current `send()` posted. At the start of `send()`, wait for any leftover handle and raise only if it has not settled. Then clear it without raising on `ERR`.

Hi @nvpohanh , those are different mechanism and each has pros / cons.
`SGLANG_DISAGG_STAGING_BUFFER`: (i) prefill gathers into staging buffer, (ii) write to decode side staging buffers, (iii) decode scatters into kv cache.

` SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_KV_PACKING`: (i) prefill gathers each decode head slice into small buffer, (ii) writes whole pages directly into decode's kv page

Staging handles **both** prefill TP > decode TP and decode TP > prefill TP.

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

When prefill attention TP is smaller than decode attention TP (e.g. TEP4 prefill -> TEP8 decode), each decode rank holds only part of a prefill rank's KV heads, so the prefill rank sends each of those decode ranks a head slice of its full-attention KV and SWA state.

Currently, each NIXL descriptor moves one small per-token head-slice region, per layer and per K/V. At high concurrency, posting that many small transfers becomes the bottleneck.

This PR gathers each decode rank's head slices into a contiguous GPU buffer first, so each descriptor moves a whole destination page. The speedup comes from page-sized transfers replacing per-token head-slice transfers.


## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->
Optional KV packing on prefill (`SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_KV_PACKING=1`, default off):

- `disaggregation/nixl/packed.py`: `PackedKVSender` gathers a decode rank's head slice of each page into a registered GPU buffer (`SGLANG_NIXL_KV_PACK_BUFFER_SIZE_MB`, default 64) with the existing staging Triton gather kernel, then posts one transfer request per batch with one page-sized descriptor per tensor and page.
- `disaggregation/nixl/conn.py`: one packer per transfer worker. When prefill attention TP < decode attention TP, full-attention KV and SWA state go through the packer; equal TP and prefill TP > decode TP keep the existing paths. The transfer worker now honors the early-send `wait_event`, as Mooncake does.
- `disaggregation/utils.py`: `kv_packable` marks SWA hybrids whose full and SWA pools are NHD `MHATokenToKVPool`s with equal K/V head dims and the same head count, without draft KV (each pool is gathered with one page size, and both are sliced with the full-attention head count).
- `environ.py`: the two variables.

## Modifications

Optional KV packing on prefill (`SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_KV_PACKING=1`, default off):

When prefill attention TP < decode attention TP, full-attention KV and SWA state go through the packer; equal TP and prefill TP > decode TP keep the existing paths. The transfer worker now honors the early-send `wait_event`, as Mooncake does.

- `environ.py`: the two variables.

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

Muse Spark Open NVFP4, TEP4 prefill / TEP8 decode on 12 GB300 via Dynamo, packing on, 1M context, no speculative decoding. | AIME26 x16 (128K max tokens), pass@1 ± SEM | 97.08 ± 0.42% |
| AIME26 x16, pass@16 | 100% |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

Same tree and nodes for both columns; only `SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_KV_PACKING` differs (0 = off, 1 = on). TEP4 prefill / TEP8 decode, AIPerf 8K input / 1K output per request with a shared 32K cached prefix, without speculative decoding. +from __future__ import annotations
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import triton
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.staging_buffer import (
+    StagingBuffer,
+    _fused_gather_to_staging_kernel,
+)
+
+
+def packed_page_indices(*, num_tensors, dst_pages, dst_num_slots):
+    """Prepped-dlist indices of one batch: the gather leaves tensor t's j-th page in
+    buffer slot t * len(dst_pages) + j; decode slot = tensor * dst_num_slots + page."""
+    num_pages = len(dst_pages)
+    src = np.arange(num_tensors * num_pages, dtype=np.int64)
+    dst = (
+        np.arange(num_tensors, dtype=np.int64)[:, None] * dst_num_slots
+        + np.asarray(dst_pages, dtype=np.int64)[None, :]
+    ).ravel()
+    return src, dst
+
+
+class PackedKVSender:
+    def __init__(
+        self, *, agent, gpu_id, size_bytes, register_memory, await_handles, prep_dlist
+    ):
+        self.agent = agent
+        self.gpu_id = gpu_id
+        self.await_handles = await_handles
+        # prep_dlist(peer_name, Nx5 strided runs, mem_kind) -> prepped dlist handle.
+        # Transfers are built from cached dlists by index, as the unpacked path does:
+        # initialize_xfer over raw descriptors costs tens of ms of CPU per batch.
+        self.prep_dlist = prep_dlist
+        self._src_handles: dict[int, object] = {}
+        self._dst_handles: dict[tuple, object] = {}
+        self.buffer = StagingBuffer(
+            size_bytes=size_bytes, device=f"cuda:{gpu_id}", gpu_id=gpu_id
+        )
+        register_memory(self.buffer.get_ptr(), self.buffer.get_size())
+        self.inflight = None
+        self._src_pointers: dict[tuple[int, ...], torch.Tensor] = {}
+
+    def _gather(
+        self,
+        *,
+        src_ptrs,
+        pages,
+        page_size,
+        src_token_bytes,
+        dst_token_bytes,
+        head_offset_bytes,
+    ):
+        num_tokens = len(pages) * page_size
+        tensor_bytes = num_tokens * dst_token_bytes
+        torch.cuda.set_device(self.gpu_id)
+        stream = self.buffer.get_gather_stream()
+        # The transfer worker already waited for the producer; keep uploads off
+        # the default stream, which prefill CUDA graph capture may be using.
+        with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+            indices = torch.tensor(pages, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.buffer.device)
+            pointers = self._src_pointers.get(tuple(src_ptrs))
+            if pointers is None:
+                pointers = torch.tensor(
+                    src_ptrs, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.buffer.device
+                )
+                self._src_pointers[tuple(src_ptrs)] = pointers
+            _fused_gather_to_staging_kernel[
+                (len(src_ptrs), triton.cdiv(tensor_bytes, 1024))
+            ](
+                pointers,
+                indices,
+                self.buffer.buffer,
+                num_tokens,
+                src_token_bytes,
+                head_offset_bytes,
+                tensor_bytes,
+                dst_token_bytes,
+                page_size,
+                1024,
+            )
+        stream.synchronize()
+
+    def _src_handle(self, page_bytes):
+        handle = self._src_handles.get(page_bytes)
+        if handle is None:
+            slots = self.buffer.get_size() // page_bytes
+            runs = np.array(
+                [(self.buffer.get_ptr(), page_bytes, self.gpu_id, page_bytes, slots)],
+                dtype=np.uint64,
+            )
+            handle = self._src_handles[page_bytes] = self.prep_dlist("", runs, "VRAM")
+        return handle
+
+    def _dst_handle(self, peer_name, dst_ptrs, page_bytes, dst_num_slots, dst_gpu_id):
+        key = (peer_name, tuple(dst_ptrs), page_bytes, dst_num_slots)
+        handle = self._dst_handles.get(key)
+        if handle is None:
+            runs = np.array(
+                [
+                    (p, page_bytes, dst_gpu_id, page_bytes, dst_num_slots)
+                    for p in dst_ptrs
+                ],
+                dtype=np.uint64,
+            )
+            handle = self._dst_handles[key] = self.prep_dlist(peer_name, runs, "VRAM")
+        return handle
+
+    def _wait(self, *, raise_on_failure=True):
+        if self.inflight is None:
+            return
+        settled, failed = self.await_handles([self.inflight], failure_seen=False)
+        if not settled:
+            # Keep the handle: subsequent requests must not overwrite NIC input.
+            raise RuntimeError("NIXL packed transfer has not settled")
+        self.inflight = None
+        if failed and raise_on_failure:
+            raise RuntimeError("NIXL packed transfer failed")
+
+    def send(
+        self,
+        *,
+        peer_name,
+        src_ptrs,
+        dst_ptrs,
+        src_pages,
+        dst_pages,
+        src_page_bytes,
+        dst_page_bytes,
+        page_size,
+        head_offset_bytes,
+        dst_gpu_id,
+        dst_num_slots,
+        handles,
+    ):
+        # The gather fills src-shaped bytes; the descriptors address dst-shaped ones.
+        if len(src_pages) != len(dst_pages) or len(src_ptrs) != len(dst_ptrs):
+            raise ValueError("NIXL packed transfer requires paired pages and tensors")
+        if not len(src_pages):
+            return
+        pages_per_batch = self.buffer.get_size() // (len(src_ptrs) * dst_page_bytes)
+        if pages_per_batch == 0:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "NIXL pack buffer cannot hold one page across all tensors; "
+                "increase SGLANG_NIXL_KV_PACK_BUFFER_SIZE_MB"
+            )
+
+        src_handle = self._src_handle(dst_page_bytes)
+        dst_handle = self._dst_handle(
+            peer_name, dst_ptrs, dst_page_bytes, dst_num_slots, dst_gpu_id
+        )
+        # A handle left by an earlier send that failed belongs to that room: wait
+        # until it no longer reads the buffer, but do not fail this room for it.
+        self._wait(raise_on_failure=False)
+        for start in range(0, len(src_pages), pages_per_batch):
+            self._wait()

+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+import triton
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.staging_buffer import (

+    _fused_gather_to_staging_kernel,
+)
+

+def packed_page_descriptors(
+    *, base_ptr, dst_ptrs, dst_pages, page_bytes, src_gpu_id, dst_gpu_id
+):
+    offsets = np.arange(len(dst_ptrs) * len(dst_pages), dtype=np.uint64)
+    src_addrs = base_ptr + offsets * np.uint64(page_bytes)
+    dst_addrs = (
+        np.asarray(dst_ptrs, dtype=np.uint64)[:, None]
+        + np.asarray(dst_pages, dtype=np.uint64)[None, :] * np.uint64(page_bytes)
+    ).ravel()
+    sizes = np.full(len(src_addrs), page_bytes, dtype=np.uint64)
+    src = np.column_stack((src_addrs, sizes, np.full_like(sizes, src_gpu_id)))
+    dst = np.column_stack((dst_addrs, sizes, np.full_like(sizes, dst_gpu_id)))
+    return src, dst
+
+
+class PackedKVSender:
+    def __init__(self, *, agent, gpu_id, size_bytes, register_memory, await_handles):
+        self.agent = agent
+        self.gpu_id = gpu_id
+        self.await_handles = await_handles
+        self.buffer = StagingBuffer(
+            size_bytes=size_bytes, device=f"cuda:{gpu_id}", gpu_id=gpu_id
+        )
+        register_memory(self.buffer.get_ptr(), self.buffer.get_size())
+        self.inflight = None
+        self._src_pointers: dict[tuple[int, ...], torch.Tensor] = {}
+
+    def _gather(
+        self,
+        *,
+        src_ptrs,
+        pages,
+        page_size,
+        src_token_bytes,
+        dst_token_bytes,
+        head_offset_bytes,
+    ):
+        num_tokens = len(pages) * page_size
+        tensor_bytes = num_tokens * dst_token_bytes
+        torch.cuda.set_device(self.gpu_id)
+        stream = self.buffer.get_gather_stream()
+        # The transfer worker already waited for the producer; keep uploads off
+        # the default stream, which prefill CUDA graph capture may be using.
+        with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+            indices = torch.tensor(pages, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.buffer.device)
+            pointers = self._src_pointers.get(tuple(src_ptrs))
+            if pointers is None:
+                pointers = torch.tensor(
+                    src_ptrs, dtype=torch.int64, device=self.buffer.device
+                )
+                self._src_pointers[tuple(src_ptrs)] = pointers
+            _fused_gather_to_staging_kernel[
+                (len(src_ptrs), triton.cdiv(tensor_bytes, 1024))
+            ](
+                pointers,
+                indices,
+                self.buffer.buffer,
+                num_tokens,
+                src_token_bytes,
+                head_offset_bytes,
+                tensor_bytes,
+                dst_token_bytes,
+                page_size,
+                1024,
+            )
+        stream.synchronize()
+
+    def _wait(self):
+        if self.inflight is None:
+            return
+        settled, failed = self.await_handles([self.inflight], failure_seen=False)
+        if not settled:
+            # Keep the handle: subsequent requests must not overwrite NIC input.
+            raise RuntimeError("NIXL packed transfer has not settled")
+        self.inflight = None
+        if failed:
+            raise RuntimeError("NIXL packed transfer failed")

Hi @nvpohanh , those are different mechanism and each has pros / cons.
`SGLANG_DISAGG_STAGING_BUFFER`: (i) prefill gathers into staging buffer, (ii) write to decode side staging buffers, (iii) decode scatters into kv cache.

` SGLANG_ENABLE_NIXL_KV_PACKING`: (i) prefill gathers each decode head slice into small buffer, (ii) writes whole pages directly into decode's kv page

Staging handles **both** prefill TP > decode TP and decode TP > prefill TP. 
Packing can handle only decode TP > prefill TP and they cannot work together.
It seems PACKING is more performant then STAGING when decode TP > prefill TP
